summary: Sen. Cory Booker (Democrat) ran for reelection and won, defeating Republican Justin Murphy.

candidates.name: Cory Booker
candidates.bio: Cory Booker is the Democratic U.S. Senator from New Jersey and a former mayor of Newark. He ran unopposed in the 2026 Democratic primary.

positions.summary: Backs the Keep Your Pay Act to make the first $75,000 of household income tax-free for most filers and expand the child tax credit.
Says health care is a human right and has led efforts to protect the Affordable Care Act.
Led colleagues in urging HHS to remove barriers that keep DACA recipients from getting health insurance through the ACA and CHIP.
Says a student's zip code should not determine their educational and economic future.
Says all Americans should have access to clean water, clean air and a healthy environment.
Introduced the Protecting National Access to Reproductive Care Act, which would affirm FDA authority over state law for FDA-approved reproductive health products including medication abortion drugs.

candidates.name: Justin Murphy
candidates.bio: Justin Murphy is a Republican attorney and former committee person in Tabernacle, Burlington County. He won the 2026 Republican Senate primary.

positions.summary: Says he would abolish the IRS and the Internal Revenue Code and adopt a flat income tax.
Says he will oppose government-run healthcare and backs Health Savings Accounts and a national insurance market.
Supports finishing the southern border wall, deploying the military to the border, and withholding federal aid from sanctuary jurisdictions.
Says he wants to abolish the federal Department of Education and supports school choice.
Says he supports expanding nuclear power and domestic energy production, with a focus on oil.
Describes himself as pro-life with exceptions for the mother's life, rape and incest, and opposes taxpayer funding of abortion.

factCheckNote: Winner matches AP-sourced tally (political.org Nov 14 tally, AP called 34 of 35)
